verdict.rationale: The only first-party supply-chain protection in the evidence is tap trust scoping: tapping a repository does not grant whole-tap trust, and installing a fully qualified item trusts only that item. That is a thin, default trust boundary rather than a switchable policy. A community user explicitly asks for a cooldown before new versions ship, which suggests no minimum-release-age control exists. missing for 10: a minimum release age or cooldown setting, blocking of install or post-install scripts, an admin-enforceable malicious-package policy, independent corroboration.
